name: Grilled Pork Sausage Bun with Veggie Relish & Tomato-Mozzarella "Caprese" Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use these recipes as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 stick celery
1 red chili pepper
½ lemon
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Peel and trim two carrots, then slice crosswise into 1/2-inch pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve remaining carrot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp oregano, dried
⅛ tsp salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until carrots are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place vinegar, sugar, and spices in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tsp brown sugar
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and small dice remaining carrot. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the pickling liquid.

Thinly slice chili pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with chilis; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl, along with capers, and stir to combine the relish. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and grill, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop or tear the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Cut or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Place a ⅔-cup on a plate and set aside. Add remaining mozzarella to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.

Slice one of the sausages in half lengthwise (to prevent choking). Split one bun, fill with both sausage halves, then cut in half crosswise to create two mini hot dogs. Add to the plate with the mozzarella.
Split remaining buns, then fill each with sausages and relish.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide mini hot dogs, roasted carrots, and reserved cheese between plates. Drizzle sausages with ketchup. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide hot dogs with relish and salad between plates. Enjoy!
